title: Germany – Underground work other than tunnels, shafts and subways – BBA, Neubau Halle 4 Neubau VE206 Tiefbauarbeiten - Baugrubenherstellung
description: Die Hamburger Hochbahn AG beabsichtigt die Vergabe der Leistungen für die Errichtung einer Baugrube für den Neubau einer U-Bahn-Werkstatthalle in Hamburg-Barmbek. Auf dem U Bahn Betriebshof Barmbek wird eine vorhandene Werkstatthalle (Halle 4) für U-Bahn-Betriebs- und Fahrgastfahrzeuge abgerissen und im Anschluss neu errichtet. Das Grundstück ist zwischen den Bahngleisen der U-Bahnlinie 3, den Bahngleisen der S-Bahnlinie 1, dem Barmbeker Stichkanal und der Hellbrookstraße gelegen. Das Baufeld befindet sich an der südlichen Grundstücksgrenzen entlang der Bahngleise der U Bahnlinie U3. Die Zufahrt zu dem Baufeld ist nur von der Hellbrookstraße aus entlang der Nord-Süd-Achse des Grundstücks möglich. Alle weiteren Gebäude und Anlagen auf dem Hof inkl. der Gleisharfe sind während der gesamten Baumaßnahme weiterhin in Betrieb. Flächen für die Baustelleneinrichtung stehen nur begrenzt zur Verfügung. Die Bestandshalle aus den 1910-er Jahren wird im Vorfeld auf einer Fläche von rd. 4.300 m² bis auf Geländeebene rückgebaut. Das Kellergeschoss bleibt bestehen und wird mit Abbruchmaterial verfüllt. Der Rückbau des Kellers erfolgt mit Aushub der Baugrube. Der Neubau umfasst eine vollflächig unterkellerte Werkstatthalle mit einer Grundfläche von rd. 5.700 m² sowie zwei aufgehenden Geschossen, die bereichsweise über der Hallendecke errichtet und für Nebenwerkstätten und Ausbildungszwecke genutzt werden

title: 6515--Serranator PTA Serration Balloon Catheters
description: DESCRIPTION: Department Of Veterans Affairs, VISN8, Network Contracting Office 8, Prosthetics Department, Tampa, FL, hereby Gives Notice of Intent to Award a Sole Source to Cagent Vascular Inc, 50 Strafford Avenue Suite 315, Wayne, Pa 19087. DELIVERABLES: The Serranator® PTA Serration Balloon Catheter is a peripheral angioplasty device from Cagent Vascular designed for the treatment of peripheral artery disease (PAD) and certain arteriovenous (AV) fistula lesions. Unlike a standard PTA balloon, it incorporates serrated scoring elements on the balloon surface that create controlled micro-incisions (micro-fissures) in the vessel wall during inflation. This approach is intended to improve lumen expansion while reducing recoil and uncontrolled dissections. [cagentvascular.com], [cagentvascular.com] KEY FEATURES Serration Remodeling Therapy (SRT) technology. Semi-compliant balloon with embedded serrated metal elements. Designed to generate focused point force rather than uniform circumferential stretching. Available in multiple balloon diameters and lengths for peripheral interventions. [cagentvascular.com], [fda.innolitics.com] THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) number is 339113. A decision by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement. Parties may identify their interest, accompanied by supporting literature to the Contracting Officer no later than 11/11/2026 at 12:00 PM EST. Responses should be sent to shirley.courtney@va.gov. Responses received will be evaluated; however, a determination by the Government not to compete the proposed procurement will be solely up to the government.

title: Rigid-Hull Inflatable Boat Rental
description: The 2d Reconnaissance Battalion (2d Recon) requires a contractor to furnish, deliver, support, maintain, and recover two 7-meter-class rigid-hull inflatable boats (RHIBs) for training operations at Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina. The contractor shall maintain one additional fully compliant RHIB at a Contractor-controlled location as a contingent standby vessel, available to replace a primary RHIB within 48 calendar hours following a Contractor-responsible failure. The requirement includes compatible trailers; required navigation, communications, and safety equipment; delivery and return transportation; vessel documentation; maintenance records; technical support; and corrective-maintenance coordination. The contractor must deliver two compliant primary RHIBs no later than 16 November 2026 and maintain their availability through 28 February 2027. The Government will provide fuel, consumables, and training execution. Solicitation M67001-27-Q-0013 is for commercial RHIB rental and support services; award will be made to the responsible quoter whose conforming quote is most advantageous to the Government considering price, technical capability, and past performance.

title: Z2NZ--Manhole Repairs at Montrose VAMC
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 2, intends to issue Solicitation 36C24227R0012 for Project Manhole Repairs at Montrose VA Medical Center, 2094 Albany Post Rd, Montrose, NY 10548. This notice is for pre-solicitation purposes only and is issued to provide advance notice of the Government's intent to solicit this construction requirement. This notice is not a request for quotes, proposals, or bids, and no contract award will be made as a result of this announcement. The official solicitation is anticipated to be posted on or about October 30, 2026, on SAM.gov, at which time all solicitation documents, including the Statement of Work, drawings, specifications, and proposal submission instructions, will be made available. This procurement is anticipated to be issued as a 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Eligible SDVOSBs are encouraged to submit an offer upon release of the solicitation. All prospective offerors must be currently registered in www.sam.gov, www.dnb.com (Duns and Bradstreet) and be registered and verified as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. The applicable NAICS Code is 238110 with a small business size standard of $19.0 million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $25,000 and $100,000. Scope of Work: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) intends to procure construction services for the rehabilitation and repair of two existing underground utility manholes located at an entrance lane of the Montrose VA facility. The project involves repairing deteriorated concrete structures surrounding the manholes to restore structural integrity, prevent water infiltration, and ensure safe vehicular access. The scope of work includes, but is not limited to, demolition and replacement of damaged concrete lids and frames, localized excavation, concrete repairs, installation of reinforcing steel, waterproofing, corrosion protection, adjustment of manhole elevations, and restoration of surrounding asphalt surfaces. The contractor shall furnish all necessary labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and services to complete the repairs, including water removal, traffic control, site preparation, testing, and final cleanup. All work shall be performed in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW), applicable construction standards, and VA facility requirements. Period of Performance: The Construction contract completion time shall be 60 calendar days from Notice to Proceed (NTP) which includes 10 days for contractor closeout. All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation.

Description: The purpose of the project is to manage the risk of on-going shoreline erosion along Delaware Avenue which is threatening the integrity of the road and a sanitary sewer utility line (8-inch force main) that runs along the northern right-of-way of the road, approximately 4 feet under the surface. The least cost alternative and selected plan identified in the feasibility study involves the removal of approximately 8,400 cubic yards (CY) of existing rubble (sand, rock, concrete and paving debris) along the shoreline and the placement of approximately 3,000 CY of rip-rap. title: Solicitation: Construct Combat Rescue Helicopter Flight Simulator Facility at Moffett ANGB
description: The Contractor shall provide non-personal services, to include all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary for the construction of a Combat Rescue Helicopter (CRH) Operational Flight Trainer (OFT) simulator facility at Moffett Air National Guard Base (ANGB), Mountain View, California. This project will provide an approximately 8,202 gross square foot building consisting of a multi-story, high bay area to house the CRH-OFT simulator, with a single-story area containing CRH mission planning, briefing and debriefing rooms, administrative areas for training and support staff, OFT maintenance and parts storage rooms, secure and non-secure telecommunication rooms, latrine facilities and mechanical, electrical and utility support rooms utilizing conventional design and construction. The building will be of permanent construction with electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, wet sprinkler fire suppression, fire detection, access control, direct digital control, and utility management. The exterior walls will be constructed with cavity wall construction including interior non-load bearing metal studs (or CMU wall backup at Simulator Bay) with gypsum board and exterior CMU veneer and metal panel. Air space and insulation to be located inside the cavity wall to meet Energy Code requirements. The primary roofing materials will be standing seam metal roofing to match other installation facilities and the perimeter sloped roof design will include a prefinished standing seam metal roof panel system over rigid insulation. The exterior walls will be constructed with cavity wall construction including interior non-load bearing metal studs (or CMU wall backup at Simulator Bay) with gypsum board and exterior CMU veneer and metal panel. Main entrance doors will be a pair of anodized aluminum storefront entrance doors with insulating glass including a sidelight. The Mechanical, Electrical, Sim Bay and secondary egress doors will be painted, insulated hollow metal door and frames with controlled access. Antiterrorism/Force Protection elements are incorporated. Supporting facilities include landscaping, utilities, pavements, storm drainage, sanitary sewer, site improvements, communications support, cybersecurity control systems, and tempest security.

title: CH-53K Program Support Under BOA N00019-19-G-0029
description: DISCLAIMER: THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. INTRODUCTION: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), Patuxent River, Maryland, is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of supporting the requirements described below. The Government anticipates modifying one or more active orders issued under Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) N0001919G0029 to extend coverage and continue performance beyond the current order periods of performance. The anticipated modifications are intended to support continued requirements associated with those presently being performed under the identified active orders. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. It is a market research tool being used to determine potential and eligible businesses capable of providing the services described herein prior to determining the method of acquisition and issuance of a Request for Proposal. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources as a result of this notice. ELIGIBILITY: Product Service Code (PSC): 15 North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 336413 All interested businesses are encouraged to respond. ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: The Government anticipates extending orders under the N0001919G0029 BOA through 30 September 2030[CH1] . The exact period of performance, scope, quantities, funding, and terms of any modification will be determined based on Government requirements, available funding, applicable authorities, and the results of this market research. ANTICIPATED CONTRACT TYPE: The Government anticipates that the contract type for any modification will be consistent with the order to be modified and the nature of the continued requirement. The BOA provides for fixed-price and cost-reimbursement ordering, as applicable. PROGRAM BACKGROUND: The CH-53K is the U.S. Marine Corps heavy-lift helicopter program and is intended to replace the legacy CH-53E aircraft. The Government requires continued technical, engineering, logistics, production, and sustainment support for CH-53K aircraft, associated subsystems, and training simulators/devices. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES: Interested sources must demonstrate the ability to provide supplies and services supporting CH-53K aircraft and training systems, including the following: Engineering Change Proposal Support Development, manufacture, installation, validation, and verification of engineering changes; Upgrades, obsolescence corrections, retrofit and production forward-fit kits; Systems engineering, production assessments, life-cycle analyses, prototyping, and technical-data/publication updates; Support equipment, tooling, spare parts, repair parts, and cost-reduction initiatives. Software and Systems Support Software development, integration, testing, and infrastructure support for CH-53K systems and subsystems; Avionics and vehicle-management-system upgrades; Training simulator/device upgrades and associated hardware modifications; Support for integrated system and computing platforms, fleet operating-environment engineering and sustainment, product-lifecycle-management system concurrency, and operational test-program sets. Testing, Logistics, and Sustainment Bench, avionics-system, qualification, developmental, operational, and integration testing; Integrated logistics support, production support, technical investigations, service-life analyses, and engineering studies; Obsolescence management, including trade studies, component testing, and bridge or life-of-type buys; Requalification of subsystems or parts; production tooling or tooling modifications; repair analyses; repair of repairables; and procurement of kits and spares. Interested businesses shall demonstrate that your company currently possesses or has authorized access to the necessary technical data, or has a viable plan to obtain, generate, or otherwise secure authorized access to the necessary technical data, and that it will be maintained throughout the duration of the effort being solicited. The effort in this procurement will satisfy the Government's minimum need. INCUMBENT: This is a follow-on requirement. The incumbent contractor is: Sikorsky, A Lockheed Martin Company, Stratford, Connecticut SUBMISSION DETAILS: Interested business shall submit a brief capabilities statement package (no more than ten (10) 8.5 x 11 inch pages, font no smaller than 12 point, 1.5 line spaced) demonstrating their ability to perform the services described herein; Documentation should be in bullet point format. The capability statement package shall be sent by email to kristin.a.furfaro@us.navy.mil and Christopher.harritt@us.navy.mil. Submissions must be received via email cited no later than 3:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on 11 November. Questions or comments regarding this notice may be addressed to Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO), Christopher J. Harritt or Contract Specialist, Kristin Furfaro at the above email addresses. All responses shall include Company Name, Company Address, Company Business Size, and Points-of-Contact (POC) including name, phone number, email address.

The project will provide permanent party housing for 250 Soldiers in closer proximity to existing unit headquarters and motor pools. The facility will be designed in accordance with current Army standard barracks design criteria. Primary facilities include living and sleeping quarters, bathrooms, storage areas, service areas, a dayroom, a self-contained heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) system, building information systems, antiterrorism measures, fire protection and alarm systems, Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV), Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS) connections, and special foundations. The estimated air-conditioning capacity is 260 tons. Supporting facilities include site development, utilities and connections, exterior lighting, paving, waterway road and pedestrian crossings, parking, sidewalks, curbs and gutters, storm drainage, information systems, landscaping, and signage. The project will include Post-Construction Award Services (PCAS) and comprehensive interior design services related to the building and furnishings. The facility will incorporate accessibility features for individuals with disabilities, cybersecurity measures, sustainability and energy-efficiency measures, and antiterrorism features in accordance with applicable Department of Defense (DoD) minimum antiterrorism standards for buildings. The facility will be designed for a minimum service life of 40 years in accordance with DoD Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) 1-200-02, including applicable requirements for energy efficiency, building envelope performance, and integrated building systems. title: Notice of Intent - BIS Annual Conference
description: This is a Notice of Intent to award a sole-source contract in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulations Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(b), which permits Contracting Officers to solicit from one source when it is determined that only one source is reasonably available to satisfy the agency�s requirement, as supplemented with additional information in this notice. The U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), Office of Acquisition Management (OAM), Shared Services Procurement Office (SSPO), located in Washington, D.C., intends to negotiate and award a sole-source contract to the Washington Hilton Hotel on behalf of the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) for conference facilities and associated services supporting the BIS Update Conference on Export Controls and Policy. The proposed acquisition is being conducted under the authority of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(b) and in accordance with 41 U.S.C. 1901. This acquisition will result in a contract for a base period for one conference event. The BIS Update Conference on Export Controls and Policy is the Department of Commerce�s flagship event addressing U.S. export controls. The Conference provides an opportunity for exporting companies to interact with U.S. Government officials who implement export control regulations, practices, and policies intended to advance U.S. national security, foreign policy, and economic interests. Presenters and attendees include high-level U.S. Government officials, foreign government and business representatives, export managers, corporate attorneys, and consultants. In addition, government and private sector vendors participate as exhibitors to offer information and services related to export control and compliance activities. Based on market research, market analysis, and site visit assessments, the proposed contractor emerged as the only vendor capable of fully meeting the agency's specific requirements for participant capacity and flexible space configuration. During market research, alternative vendors were evaluated, but none demonstrated the same level of capacity, capability and flexibility, essential for our event's unique requirements. Specifically, Washington Hilton Hotel demonstrated the ability to accommodate approximately 1,630 participants in both theater seating and round-table lunch arrangements without compromising comfort, accessibility, or operational efficiency. This flexibility is indispensable to our commitment to a high-quality participant experience and is a capability no other vendor demonstrated during the vetting process. As previously stated, this is NOT a solicitation for quotations, quotation abstracts, a request for competitive quotations; or request for competitive proposals; There is no solicitation package available for review due to the Government�s intention to conduct this requirement as a sole source award. Information received will normally be considered for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Information received on this notice must eliminate the Government's concerns and address how the required services can be provided. If no qualified/affirmative responses are received within 15 days of this notice to determine whether a qualified source is more advantageous to the Government, a contract will be awarded to Washington Hilton Hotel.

Jefferson Barracks National Cemetery is one (1) of three (3) Missouri -based national cemeteries. It is located in St. Louis, Missouri. The address is 2900 Sheridan Rd., St Louis, MO 63125. BACKGROUND National cemeteries are National Shrines under 38 U.S.C. § 2403(c). The Contractor is responsible for planning and performing the activities described in this Statement of Work in a manner consistent with that standard and shall exercise special care not to interrupt or disrupt cemetery operations. Strict adherence to the specifications described herein based on NCA's National Shrine Commitment, Operational Standards and Measures is mandatory. title: Project Labor Agreement (PLA) Notice for the Construction Services of Crowninshield/Cressy Pier and Waterfront Building at USMMA Kings Point, NY
description: THIS IS A PROJECT LABOR AGREEMENT (PLA) NOTICE TO BE USED FOR MARKET ANALYSIS ONLY. NO AWARDS WILL BE MADE FROM THE RESPONSES TO THIS SYNOPSIS. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS SYNOPSIS OR ANY FOLLOW UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. NO SOLICITATION WILL BE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME; HOWEVER RESPONSES WILL BE USED TO DETERMINE THE APPROPRIATE ACQUISITION STRATEGY FOR A FUTURE ACQUISITION. NO RESPONSES TO THIS PLA NOTICE WILL BE POSTED TO SAM.GOV. The purpose of this announcement is to gain knowledge of the use and benefits of Project Labor Agreements (PLAs) for the Construction Services of Crowninshield/Cressy Pier and Waterfront Building at Kings Point, NY.. The NAICS Code is 236220 (Commercial and Institutional Building Construction) and 237990 (Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. Any potential competitive solicitation(s) that may proceed from this notice will be posted to SAM.gov. All interested offerors will have the opportunity to respond to a solicitation announcement at a later time if and when a solicitation is issued. BACKGROUND AND INFORMATION FOR CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT The New York District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (District) is preparing to issue a solicitation for the Construction Services of Crowninshield/Cressy Pier and Waterfront Building at Kings Point, NY. The NAICS codes for this procurement are 236220 and 237990. The project is planned to be solicited in the Fall of 2027 with construction to begin early in 2028. The estimated magnitude of construction cost is between $100,000,000 and $120,000,00.00. The project will be constructed within the access-controlled installation of the United States Merchant Marine Academy, Kings Point, NY. The building will be new construction in the Waterfront Section of the United States Merchant Marine Academy. Adjacent facilities will remain occupied during construction with minimal disruption to operations requiring precise construction planning. Work for this project is described below: 1. Project Purpose and Program Context USACE and USMMA have undertaken an agreement to modernize the campus in its entirety providing upgraded Barracks, Academic Buildings, Training Buildings, Athletic Facilities and Waterfront Spaces. The Crowninshield/Cressy Pier will serve as the premier facility showcasing the Academy as the Nation�s top Maritime training institution. ________________________________________ 2. Existing Conditions and Demolition Scope The existing site has the remains of the previous Cressy Pier which consisted of a stone jetty, timber pier and timber framed building. The Hague Basin was recently dredged in 2026 to between 15�-17� deep. There are floating wave attenuators currently installed to attempt to provide some level of protection to the basin, the removal of which will be required prior to the construction of the new pier and building. ________________________________________ 3. Reconstruction Scope and Facility Capabilities This project will create a new pier in the footprint of the former Cressy Pier to protect the basin, reduce seawall degradation and provide academic space to the Academy. The building must be constructed to support the department�s operational requirements. This includes restoring lost dock space and ensuring existing docks can support daily operations and visiting vessels. Infrastructure improvements must also account for large-scale events, such as Fleet Week and alumni gatherings, which demand expanded facilities and robust support systems. The addition of fire training classes, a Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Lab, and a seamen ship facility are also needed to ensure comprehensive training capabilities. Additionally, it will enable USMMA to launch and recover lifeboats. The new pier will also offer midshipmen new recreational opportunities, such as sailing, paddleboarding, and kayaking. ________________________________________ 4. Design Standards and Performance Requirements The facility will be fully designed for accessibility and usability by individuals with disabilities. All work will meet the USMMA Campus Design Guide and Engineering Design Standards which contain DOT standards including the International Building Code (IBC), GSA standards, and DoD Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC). ________________________________________ 5. Acquisition Strategy and Contracting Approach The acquisition approach incorporates early contractor involvement utilizing the federal government�s Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) framework to support design completion and ensure constructability. The solicitation will be issued at approximately 15% design. The anticipated Magnitude of Construction is between $100 million and $120 million. Duration of construction will be approximately 730 calendar days after Notice to Proceed. Notice to Proceed is anticipated to occur approximately in February 2028. DEFINITIONS A Project Labor Agreement (PLA) is defined as a pre-hire collective bargaining agreement with one or more labor organizations that establishes the terms and conditions of employment for a specific construction project and is an agreement described in 29 U.S.C. 158(f). A large-scale construction project means a Federal construction project within the United States for which the total estimated cost of the construction contract to the Federal Government is $35 million or more. Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) SUBPART 22.502-1 � POLICY Executive Order (E.O.) 14063, Use of Project Labor Agreements for Federal Construction Projects, requires agencies to use project labor agreements in large-scale construction projects to promote economy and efficiency in the administration and completion of Federal construction projects. When awarding a contract in connection with a large-scale construction project agencies must require use of project labor agreements for contractors and subcontractors engaged in construction on the project, unless an exception at 22.502(d) applies. An agency may require the use of a project labor agreement on projects where the total cost to the Federal Government is less than that for a large-scale construction project, if appropriate. (1) An agency may, if appropriate, require that every contractor and subcontractor engaged in construction on the project agree, for that project, to negotiate or become a party to a project labor agreement with one or more labor organizations if the agency decides that the use of project labor agreements will� (i) Advance the Federal Government's interest in achieving economy and efficiency in Federal procurement, producing labor-management stability, and ensuring compliance with laws and regulations governing safety and health, equal employment opportunity, labor and employment standards, and other matters; and (ii) Be consistent with law. (2) Agencies may consider the following factors in deciding whether the use of a project labor agreement is appropriate for a construction project where the total cost to the Federal Government is less than that for a large-scale construction project: (i) The project will require multiple construction contractors and/or subcontractors employing workers in multiple crafts or trades. (ii) There is a shortage of skilled labor in the region in which the construction project will be sited. (iii) Completion of the project will require an extended period of time. (iv) Project labor agreements have been used on comparable projects undertaken by Federal, State, municipal, or private entities in the geographic area of the project. (v) A project labor agreement will promote the agency's long term program interests, such as facilitating the training of a skilled workforce to meet the agency's future construction needs. (vi) Any other factors that the agency decides are appropriate. title: Sirturo (Bedaquiline) tablets for the NIH (Notice of Intent to sole source)
description: Acquisition Description: This is a Notice of Intent, not a request for proposal. The National Institute of Health, Clinical Center (NIH-CC) intends to negotiate on an other than full and open competition basis with Cardinal Health. This requirement will be sole sourced to Cardinal Health under FAR 13.501(a) or 8.405-6 (b) - sole source requirements. The National Institutes of Health (NIH) Clinical Center (CC) (NIH-CC or �Program�) is a clinical research hospital providing all medical services for patients participating in human research protocols of the NIH. The CC Pharmacy department provides a range of pharmaceutical care services to inpatients and outpatients enrolled in clinical trials. The CC Pharmacy department is responsible for acquiring the supply of medications required for patient care. The NIH-CC has a pharmacy center that requires Sirturo (Bedaquiline) drug tablets for patient care. Sirturo is supplied in the following forms: 100 mg tablets in 188 count bottles and 20 mg tablets in 60 count bottles. Various different quantities are needed every year. Based on Program�s purchase history in the past, and factoring in the anticipated patient enrollment, Program expects to need approximately 12 - 36 bottles of each type of Sirturo� bottles per year. Justification: Only this Sirturo medication can be accepted as there are no substitutes for this medication. The manufacturer (Janssen Therapeutics) has designated Cardinal Health (DBA Metro Medical Supply) as the sole distributor of Sirturo in the U.S. Previous acquisitions and research indicated that this requirement should be a sole source requirement. For the previous acquisitions, Notice of Intent notices were posted on SAM.gov. Cardinal Health/Metro Medical was the only sole source provider. In order to confirm this is still applicable, this requirement was previously posted on SAM.gov as an RFQ under full and open competition under RFQ-CC-24-008485. No other companies responded, and it was confirmed by this posting that they are the sole source vendor. Previous acquisitions and research revealed this requirement should be a sole source requirement. More recently, a Request for Quotes was posted under RFQ-CC-24-008485 and it was reconfirmed that Cardinal Health/Metro Medical is the sole source vendor as they are the official authorized reseller of this equipment via their relationship with the manufacturer. Thus, Cardinal Health/Metro Medical is the only responsible and authorized source for Sirturo. Requirements: SIRTURO (BEDAQUILINE) 100 mg tablet in 188-count bottles (NDC# 59676070101) SIRTURO (BEDAQUILINE) 20 mg tablet in 60-count bottles (NDC#59676070260) Period of performance/Date of Delivery: Within 30 days of award, or mutually agreed upon. Place of Performance or Delivery: Place of Performance: NIH Clinical Center in Bethesda, MD The statutory authority for this sole source requirement is 41 U.S.C. 1901 (a) (1) as implemented by FAR 13.106-1 only one responsible source and no other supply of service will satisfy agency requirements. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. All responsible sources that could provide the required may submit a capability statement that will be considered by email (subject line to reference NOI-27-000056) by 04:00 PM eastern standard time on 11/11/2026 to: lu-chang.lu@nih.gov All responses received by the closing date of this synopsis will be considered by the Government. title: Q501--Anesthesiology Staffing Services
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs, VISN 08, Bay Pines Veterans Affairs Healthcare System, (BPVAHCS) located at 10000 Bay Pines Blvd, Bay Pines, FL 33744 is looking for certified, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) for the following capable of providing the requirement described below. This notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. Requirement Description: The Contractor shall provide Board Certified Anesthesiology Physician and Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) services onsite in accordance with the specifications contained herein to beneficiaries of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the Bay Pines VA Medical Center. The VA Full-Time Equivalency (FTE): FTE is defined by VA as a minimum of 80 hours every two (2) The VA Full-Time Equivalency (FTE) is defined as a minimum of 80 hours every two weeks, excluding Federal holidays. A minimum of two (2) Board Certified Anesthesiologists and seven (7) Board Certified CRNAs. The contractor employees and subcontractors must maintain required licenses, permits, and certifications. Contractor personnel must be proficient in all technical skills required and be able to speak, read, write, and understand English fluently. The Contractor shall provide verification documents upon request from the Contracting Officer (CO) or Contracting Officer s Representative (COR), including evidence of ongoing competency, training, education, and explanations for any gaps in professional history. Contractor personnel shall comply with all applicable VA Medical Staff By Laws, Rules, and Regulations. SDVOSB/VOSB Verification Requirement: SDVOSBs must be certified through the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) under the Veterans Certification (VetCert) Program. Certification status must be verifiable through SBA s VetCert system at: https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/. Submission Guidance: This is not a request for competitive proposals. However, firms that believe they can meet the Government s requirements are invited to submit a capability statement. Any response must provide clear and convincing evidence demonstrating that competition would be advantageous to the Government. Only responses submitted by authorized representatives of the firm will be accepted. Response Deadline: Responses are due no later than November 11, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST. The North America Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 561320 Temporary Help Services, Product Service Code is Q501 Medical Anesthesiology and Business Size Standard is 34.0 million. Point of Contact(s): Rosetta Quinn, 813-893-1814, Rosetta.quinn@va.gov. Disclaimer (FAR 15.201(e)): This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or authorization to begin work. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Proprietary information submitted will be handled accordingly. Respondents are responsible for all expenses associated with preparing and submitting responses to this RFI.

title: Finland – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Kansallinen ilmastoriski- ja haavoittuvuustarkastelu
description: Maa- ja metsätalousministeriö (”hankintayksikkö”) vastaa ilmastonmuutokseen sopeutumistyön koordinoinnista valtioneuvostotasolla. Ministeriö vastaa kansallisen ilmastonmuutokseen sopeutumissuunnitelman ja sen taustamateriaalien (ml. kansallisen ilmastoriski- ja haavoittuvuustarkastelun) valmistelusta ilmastolain mukaisesti. Maa- ja metsätalousministeriön tarkoituksena on hankkia valtakunnallisen ilmastoriski- ja haavoittuvuustarkastelun suunnittelu, toteutus ja raportointi. Riski- ja haavoittuvuustarkastelun tulosten tulisi olla käytettävissä, kun kansallisen sopeutumissuunnitelman valmistelu aloitetaan seuraavan vaalikauden alussa. Kansallisen ilmastoriski- ja haavoittuvuustarkastelun valmistelun tavoitteena on saada parhaaseen käytettävissä olevaan tietoon perustuva käsitys Suomeen kohdistuvista ilmasto-riskeistä ja haavoittuvuuksista sekä vahvistaa yhteyttä riskien ja haavoittuvuuksien arvioinnin ja sopeutumispolitiikan suunnittelun välillä. Tarkastelun tulee tukea nykyistä vahvemmin sopeutumistoimien kohdentamista niihin riskeihin, vaikutuksiin ja haavoittuvuuksiin, joiden arvioidaan olevan merkittävimpiä suomalaiselle yhteiskunnalle. Samalla tarkastelun tulisi tunnistaa uusia tai tarkentaa tietoa aiemmin tunnistetuista riskeistä sekä kuvata mahdollisia tietopuutteita. Ilmastolaki edellyttää alueellista tarkastelua tarpeen mukaan. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu liitteessä 1 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus.

title: Tilbudsindhentning - Kapitalforvaltning 2026
description: Egedal Kommune har til hensigt at indgå to rammeaftaler om kapitalforvaltning. Rammeaftalerne indgås med baggrund i Lov om kommunernes styrelses, § 44 samt bekendtgørelsen nr. 1525 af 28. oktober 2020 (Anbringelsesbekendtgørelsen) og i henhold til Egedal Kommunes Finansielle Politik. De to rammeaftaler om kapitalforvaltning har en samlet beløbsramme på op til 400 mio. DKK. Den ene rammeaftale (Delaftale 1) er et balanceret mandat med en forventet beløbsramme på op til 225 mio. DKK. Rammeaftalen for det balancerede mandat kan kun bestå af aktivklassefordelingen, der fastsættes i kommunens finansielle politik. Den anden rammeaftale (Delaftale 2) består af et mandat til en REPO-aftale til fortsat optimering af Egedal Kommunes driftslikviditet, med en forventet beløbsramme på op til 175 mio. DKK. Rammeaftalen for REPO-mandatet er underlagt krav om en portefølje bestående af danske stats- og realkreditobligationer. Beløbsrammen for rammeaftalerne er baseret på et estimat og er ikke forpligtende for ordregiver. Tilbudsgiver kan byde på begge rammeaftaler særskilt, eller blot én af rammeaftalerne. Tilbuddene vil blive vurderet pr. rammeaftale uafhængig af hinanden.

title: France – Statistical services – Prestation d’ingénierie en matière de traitements et d’analyse de données, d'études statistiques et de restitutions de données
description: La présente consultation a pour objet la passation de marchés publics portant sur la réalisation de prestations d'ingénierie en matière de traitements de données, d'analyses, d'études statistiques et de restitutions, ainsi que de prestations de migration, d'amélioration, de mise à jour de code, d'optimisation, de recettage et de documentation de programmes, notamment dans le cadre de la migration de traitements existants et de l'amélioration des codes existants. Ces prestations ont notamment pour finalité de permettre à l’ATIH de mobiliser, en fonction de ses besoins, des compétences techniques et méthodologiques spécialisées afin de réaliser des traitements de données, des analyses et études statistiques, des restitutions ainsi que des prestations de migration, d’amélioration et de mise à jour de code. Elles pourront concerner l’ensemble des données collectées ou traitées par l’ATIH, notamment les données d’information médicale, financières, relatives aux coûts ou aux ressources humaines. Le détail des prestations à exécuter figure dans le cahier des clauses techniques particulières commun aux lots (CCTPC). Les prestations font l’objet d’un allotissement : lot n°1 : Prestation d’ingénierie en matière de traitements de données, d’analyses et études statistiques et de restitutions ; lot n°2 : Prestation de migration, d’amélioration et de mise à jour de code. Chaque lot donne lieu à la conclusion d’un marché public séparé. Chaque marché est conclu avec les quantités minimum et maximum suivantes exprimées en jours d’intervention pour leur durée totale, reconductions comprises : Lot 1 : minimum 100 jours et maximum 1 040 jours (hors pilotage et déplacement sur site) ; Lot 2 : minimum 30 jours et maximum 300 jours (hors pilotage et déplacement sur site).

In accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) Subpart 208.74, the Government intends to satisfy this requirement through an existing DoD Enterprise Software Initiative (ESI) Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA). As such, the primary purpose of this notice is to survey and assess the capability and availability of sources through current DoD ESI BPA to satisfy the requirements outlined in Section 3. 2.2. title: Homeland Security and Innovation Center (HSIC) - Executive Education Seminar Services
description: HSIC, located at Joint Force Headquarters�Massachusetts, supports the National Guard by connecting senior-leader education with the evolving challenges of homeland security, emergency management, crisis leadership, and innovation. Its education mission includes General and Flag Officer Seminar (GFOS) and Leadership in Homeland Security (LHS) audiences. The seminars emphasize rigorous academic study, case-based analysis, facilitated discussion, critical thinking, and peer networking in a university setting. The curriculum should address National Guard roles in complex domestic response and intergovernmental coordination and, as appropriate to each seminar, emerging challenges such as artificial intelligence, cyber threats, small unmanned aircraft systems/counter-sUAS, and innovation. Inclusion and emphasis of these topics remain subject to HSIC/GOMO mission validation. The broader HSIC innovation/incubation mission does not automatically expand the scope of this seminar-services requirement. MARKET RESEARCH FEEDBACK REQUESTED Institutions are invited to comment on academic capability, delivery and pricing feasibility, and requirements that may unnecessarily constrain participation. Responses should identify the affected section, explain the practical or financial impact, and propose alternatives that preserve HSIC educational quality. Contracting will determine final response instructions. Academic institution and faculty qualifications: experience educating GOs or comparable senior executives; relevant faculty credentials; impact of tenured-Ph.D./ten-year criteria. GFOS and LHS differentiation: recommended objectives, topics, and approaches appropriate to each audience; capability to address AI, cyber, sUAS/cUAS, and innovation. Case-study pedagogy and research: existing course adaptation, case-study counts, original case development, guest speaker access, realistic research and approval timelines. Seminar capacity, location, and duration: in-person facilities for 65 plus support staff; viable course lengths; scheduling lead times; capacity for multiple annual iterations. Enrollment and pricing: ability to handle 40 Government-funded and up to 25 direct-pay seats; tuition-only versus standard bundled seminar pricing; minimum cohort sizes. Intellectual property: rights and restrictions for pre-existing materials versus Government-funded new case studies; possible licensing and reuse models. Participation barriers: federal contracting, administrative requirements, location, security, teaming, and any provisions that materially affect willingness or ability to compete. TARGETED UNIVERSITY FEEDBACK QUESTIONS � ACADEMIC AND BUSINESS FEASIBILITY Which performance outcomes and academic quality indicators best demonstrate that an executive education program meets HSIC needs? Which specific faculty criteria, if any, would prevent your institution from competing, and what evidence of equivalent academic quality could you provide? What case-study-based instructional model would you propose, and how would HSIC verify the quality of learning? What enrollment, lead time, and annual frequency would make participation financially viable for your institution? How would your institution price standard bundled tuition, meals, books, and facilities compared with a tuition-only arrangement, if available? Which administrative or payment requirements (including direct-pay seats and federal contracting) would discourage a response, and what alternatives could address them? Based on this draft PWS, what specific requirements or business conditions would discourage your institution from competing? Would your institution be interested in competing? If not, what changes would materially affect that decision? SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS & INSTRUCTIONS Interested academic institutions who believe they have the capability to perform this requirement are invited to submit their feedback and Capability Statement. The Government will not pay for any information submitted in response to this notice, nor will it reimburse any costs incurred by respondents. All information received in response to this notice marked "Proprietary" will be handled accordingly. Responses will not be returned, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to respondents. 2. REQUIREMENT BACKGROUND & SCOPE The National Guard Bureau�s Operational Contracting Division (NGB-AQ-C), on behalf of the Air National Guard Surgeon General�s Office (NGB/SGOK), is conducting market research to identify sources capable of performing non-personal Centralized Clinical Quality Management (CQM) and Credentialing and Privileging (C&P) Program Management Services. This effort is a follow-on requirement to Contract No. W9133L22C1003. In accordance with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 6025.13, Defense Health Agency Procedures Manual (DHA-PM) 6025.13, Air Force Instruction (AFI) 44-119, and DAFMAN 10-211, the scope has modernized to incorporate full clinical quality management and line-side embedded healthcare support. Key requirement objectives include: � Credentialing and Privileging (C&P) Administration: Centralized management and maintenance of electronic Provider Credential Files (ePCFs) within the Joint Centralized Credentials Quality Assurance System (CCQAS) for approximately 2,500 military and non-military Health Care Providers (HCPs) across 90+ ANG Wings and Joint Force State HQs. � Board Operations: Full administrative, scheduling, technical, and data management support for quarterly Centralized Credentialing and Privileging Boards (CCPB) and out-of-cycle fast-track privileging actions. � Primary Source Verification (PSV): Timely initiation and execution of paid and non-paid PSVs directly from issuing bodies for all provider accessions, re-privileging, and medical special pay verifications. � Health Risk Management & Adverse Actions: Maintenance of adverse action files, tracking mandatory timelines, hearing board facilitation, and administration of National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Continuous Query (CQ) monitoring and fee management. � Clinical Quality Management Support: Providing advanced clinical Subject Matter Expertise via a Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) to direct MHS-mandated Accreditation & Compliance (AC), Clinical Measurements (CM), and Clinical Quality Improvement (CQI) initiatives. � Embedded Healthcare Support: Tracking and monitoring line-side embedded medical personnel and Integrated Operations Support (IOS) personnel via AFMEDCOM tracking applications. 3. ANTICIPATED CONTRACT DETAILS � Acquisition Strategy: Market research will determine small business set-aside feasibility. � Contract Type: Anticipated Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) with Cost-Reimbursable (No-Fee) CLINs for authorized travel and paid primary source verifications. � Period of Performance: Anticipated one (1) 12-month base period plus four (4) 12-month option periods starting September 2027. � Applicable Codes: - NAICS Code: 541990 � All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services ($19.5M Small Business Size Standard) - PSC: Q701 � Support: Medical - Healthcare 4. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS & INSTRUCTIONS Interested, capable businesses are invited to submit a Capabilities Statement / Executive Summary that demonstrates their ability to satisfy the stated requirements. Submissions shall not exceed three (3) pages (8.5" x 11" format, 12-point font, 1-inch margins) and must include: 1. Company Information: Name, address, CAGE code, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), and primary Point of Contact (POC) details (name, title, email, phone number). 2. Business Size & Socioeconomic Status: Specify size status under NAICS 541990 (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), WOSB, EDWOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone). If 8(a), include entry and exit dates. 3. Existing Contract Vehicles: Identify any active GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS), GSA OASIS+, or other GWAC/Governmentwide contract vehicles held by your company under which this work could be procured. 4. Technical Capabilities: Demonstrated capability and relevant experience in: - Operating and managing ePCFs within CCQAS (or comparable DoD/DHA provider management systems). - Conducting high-volume Primary Source Verifications (PSV) and administering NPDB continuous queries. - Managing medical credentialing boards (CCPB) and provider adverse action case workflows. - Delivering Clinical Quality Management (CQM) oversight and clinical nurse specialist (CNS) support in accordance with DoDI 6025.13. 5. Relevant Past Performance: No more than three (3) relevant past or present projects (Government or commercial) within the past five years detailing customer, contract number, dollar value, and scope description. 6. Subcontracting / Teaming & Limitations: If teaming or subcontracting is contemplated, describe the management structure. Under FAR 52.219-14, the small business prime must perform at least 50% of the cost of contract performance incurred for personnel. Confirm your company's ability to satisfy this requirement. 5. SUBMISSION DEADLINE & POINTS OF CONTACT Submissions must be received electronically via email no later than 5:00 PM EST on 11 November 2026. Please submit responses via email to both points of contact below: � Contracting Officer: MAJ Orlando Castro Vallescorbo � orlando.castrovallescorbo@army.mil � Contract Specialist: MAJ Guy J. Maily � guy.j.maily.mil@army.mil Please use the following subject line in your email submission: "Sources Sought Response: NGB ANG CQM and C&P Services - [Company Name]"

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Anteilen "Neugestaltung Ortsmitte", Gemeinde Heikendorf
description: Im Rahmen des Städtebauförderungsprogramms „Lebendige Zentren“ lobt die Gemeinde Heikendorf einen freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Anteilen aus. Ziel des Wettbewerbs ist die Entwicklung innovativer und ortsangepasster Freiraumkonzepte als Grundlage für die anschließende Neuordnung der öffentlichen Frei- und Verkehrsflächen in der Ortsmitte der Gemeinde Heikendorf. Der Handlungsbedarf zur Umgestaltung und Aufwertung der Ortsmitte wurde in der Fortschreibung des integrierten städtebaulichen Entwicklungskonzepts von 2025 (GOS mbH) hervorgehoben. Darin wird die Durchführung eines freiraumplanerischen Wettbewerbs als vorbereitende Maßnahme benannt. Mit dem Verfahren soll ein Transformationsprozess angestoßen werden, hin zu einer nachhaltig und attraktiv gestalteten Ortsmitte für alle Bevölkerungsgruppen der Gemeinde. Das Wettbewerbsgebiet umfasst die Dorfstraße als zentrale Achse zwischen den Straßen Dreangel im Osten und Teichtor im Westen. Besonderer Schwerpunkt ist die Neuordnung im Bereich Dorfplatz, ehemaliger Schule und Parkplatz am Schulredder zur Schaffung einer identitätsstiftenden Ortsmitte mit Wohnen, Kultur, Einzelhandel, Gastronomie und öffentlichen Nutzungen. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung des Areals am Schmiedeplatz als bestehendem Nahversorgungsstandort. Aufgrund der engen räumlichen und funktionalen Zusammenhänge ist für diese Bereiche eine einheitliche, in sich abgestimmte Freiraumplanung von besonderer Bedeutung. Übergeordnete Ziele für die Neugestaltung des Wettbewerbsgebiets sind: • Schaffung von qualitätvollen Aufenthaltsbereichen und Erhöhung der Verweildauer im öffentlichen Raum • Qualitative Aufwertung von Wegebeziehungen und Verbesserung für den Rad- und Fußverkehr • Barrierefreie Gestaltung • Berücksichtigung von Klimaschutz und Klimafolgeanpassung

title: Germany – Boiler installations – Neubeschaffung von zwei baugleichen Heißwassererzeuger für den Standort Köpenick
description: Wir verweisen hiermit auf die Ausschreibung Nr. 2026005415 die eine ähnliche Beschaffungsart aufweist. Am Standort des BHKW Köpenick müssen die beiden baugleichen Heißwassererzeugungsanlagen HWE 40 und HWE 50 gegen nahezu leistungsidentische Neuanlagen als Großwasserraumkesselausführung (nach EN 12953) ersetzt werden. Der HWE 40 ist seit mehreren Jahren außer Betrieb und lediglich HWE 50 ist zurzeit noch neben HWE 30 in Betrieb. Um die Versorgungssicherheit am Standort nicht zu gefährden bzw. nicht weiter einzuschränken ist ein schrittweises Vorgehen für den Ersatz von zuerst HWE 40 und nachfolgend von HWE 50 zwingend notwendig. Die beiden neu zu errichtenden Heißwassererzeuger sollen wieder unterhalb der Kesselhausdecke an die bestehenden Rauchgaskanäle angeschlossen werden. Zur ganzteiligen Ein- und Ausbringung der HWE sollen ausreichend groß dimensionierte Tor-/Türanlagen errichtet werden. Der Umfang der Ausschreibung umfasst vollumfänglich alle Leistungen, die für den Ersatz der eingangs beschriebenen Heißwassererzeuger zu betriebsfertigen Neuanlagen notwendig sind. Dazu gehören die Planung und das Detail-Engineering (Bau, Mechanik und Elektro-/Leittechnik), der Rückbau bestehender Altanlagen (inkl. Störkantenbeseitigung), die Lieferung, Montage und Verrohrung (wasser- und rauchgasseitig) der neuen Kessel inklusive der für den Betrieb notwendigen Ausrüstung (Messtechnik, Armaturen, Pumpen, Gasregelstrecke, Kesselsteuerschrank usw.) sowie die Inbetriebnahme der Kessel. Alle neu installierten Komponenten müssen hinsichtlich ihrer Bedienung- und Wartungsbereiche leicht zugänglich sein bzw. leicht zugänglich gemacht oder bedient werden können. Sollte dafür Stahlbaubühnen/-podeste umgebaut bzw. neu notwendig werden ist dies ebenfalls im Leistungsumfang des AN. Die Erfüllung aller gültigen Richtlinien, Gesetzen, Vorschriften und Normen werden für den eingangs beschriebenen Leistungsumfang des AN werden vorausgesetzt.

description: SBH | Schulbau Hamburg hat als Landesbetrieb der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg (nachstehend SBH genannt) die Aufgabe, die Schulimmobilien unter Berücksichtigung der schulischen Belange und weitere Gebäude mit nicht schulischer Nutzung, nach wirtschaftlichen Grundsätzen zu planen, zu bauen, zu unterhalten und zu bewirtschaften, und die mehr als 400 Schulen und 17 weitere Gebäude an die Behörde für Schule und Berufsbildung (BSB) zu vermieten. Die GMH | Gebäudemanagement Hamburg GmbH (nachstehend GMH genannt) ist ein städtisches Unternehmen, welches u.a. für über 50 allgemeinbildende Schulimmobilien im Süden Hamburgs (Wilhelmsburg und Harburg) sowie für Gebäude des Sport- und Sonderbaus die Dienstleistungen des Baus, des Betriebes und der Bewirtschaftung wahrnimmt. Die Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Finanzbehörde, SBH und GMH als Auftraggeber (AG) vergeben die wiederkehrende PrüfVO Prüfung gemäß Gesetz und Verordnungsblatt PrüfVO 2025_GVBL_HH_2025-40, entsprechend dem Leistungsverzeichnis, an den Standorten (WE) der staatlichen Schulen sowie an diversen Immobilien von GMH – Hochschulbau | Sport und Sonderimmobilien (ca. 415 bei SBH und ca. 76 bei GMH) in Hamburg. Die wiederkehrend zu prüfenden elektrotechnischen Anlagen sind gemäß Artikel 2, § 2, Satz 1 PrüfVO: - 6. Brandmelde- und Alarmierungsanlagen - 7. elektrische Anlagen einschließlich der Sicherheitsstromversorgungen Die Prüfung der elektrischen Anlage beschränkt sich bei baulichen Anlagen nach PrüfVO, Artikel 2, § 1, Satz 1 Nummer 7 (in allgemeinbildenden und berufsbildenden Schulen) auf die Sicherheitsstromversorgung. Ausschließlich in Versammlungsstätten ist neben der Sicherheitsbeleuchtung auch die allgemeine Elektroanlage (Starkstromanlage) prüfpflichtig. Der Gesamtauftrag wird in vier Lose unterteilt. Grundsätzlich sind die Standorte regional zugeordnet mit Ausnahme von der Region HIBB (berufliche Schulen), in Los 2, in der die Standorte über das gesamte Stadtgebiet verteilt sind. Im Los 4 (Region Süd, GMH) befinden sich die Schulstandorte im Süden Hamburgs. Die Gebäude des Sport- und Sonderbaus (GMH) sind über das gesamte Stadtgebiet Hamburgs verteilt. Die Angebotsabgabe ist für ein bis alle Lose möglich. Für Los 3 und Los 4 ist die Angebotsabgabe nur in Kombination möglich. Los 4 umfasst (Schul-)Standorte der GMH, die im Jahr 2029 zu prüfen sind. Dieses Los kann nur gemeinsam mit Los 3 (Prüfjahre 2027 und 2028) an einen AN vergeben werden. Ein AN kann aus Gründen der Mittelstandsförderung sowie zur Absicherung der Erbringung der Leistung maximal den Zuschlag für zwei Lose erhalten. Es wird das jeweils wirtschaftlichste Angebot bezuschlagt, sofern sich daraus eine Bezuschlagung pro Bieter von nicht mehr als zwei Losen ergibt. Die Bezuschlagung erfolgt unter der Berücksichtigung der genannten Wertungskriterien sowie unter der Voraussetzung, dass die Eignungsanforderungen und die Mindestanforderungen pro Los in addierter Form (abhängig davon wie viele Lose zur Bezuschlagung kommen sollen) erfüllt sind. Eine Limitierung erfolgt, wenn ein Bieter auf mehr als zwei Lose das wirtschaftlichste Angebot abgegeben hat. In diesem Fall erfolgt die Vergabe der Lose an die Bieter so, dass der AG den geringstmöglichen Gesamtpreis (brutto) – bezogen auf alle Lose – realisieren kann. Anschließend erhält die Firma mit der nächsthöchsten Gesamtpunktzahl (Konzept plus Preis) den Zuschlag für ein oder mehrere übrige Lose. Bei Punktgleichheit ist der niedrigste Preis ausschlaggebend. Die Eignungskriterien und Nachweise sind der Leistungsbeschreibung, ab Ziffer 3 zu entnehmen.

description: In the Bolivian High Plateau ("Altiplano") rural families rely on agriculture, livestock farming, and other economic activities -such as tourism and trade- to sustain their livelihoods. However, an acute soil degradation, frosts, droughts, hailstorms, and strong winds reduce productivity and increase the vulnerability of rural communities. Compounding this issue is migration to urban centres and other regions from youth and women. According to the National Institute of Statistics (INE, 2025), more than 50% of rural families in the Altiplano live under poverty line, with limited access to technical, financial, and innovation services. All these factors result in greater vulnerability to climate change and a reduced adaptive capacity. In response Bolivia committed to achieve Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) by 2030 through soil restoration, climate resilience, and biodiversity conservation; under the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). Sustainable soil management is a fundamental pillar for restoring soil health and strengthening agrifood systems and ecosystems resilience. Hence, the German Cooperation together with national subnational stakeholders, producers and civil society organizations will implement the Sustainable Soil Management for agrifood system adaptation and resilience Project (SUAGRI) to foster soil management through a comprehensive approach. This approach includes strengthening the political, regulatory, and institutional framework; developing a soil information and monitoring system; fostering soil technological innovation; managing bioinputs; and ensuring access to public and private financing mechanisms to farmers. SUAGRI aims to improve and consolidate the political, regulatory, technical, and financial enable conditions to scale up sustainable soil management and biodiversity restoration in the Bolivian Altiplano. Thus, it contributes to increase agrifood systems and ecosystems resilience improving the livelihoods of households. SUAGRI proposes four components, described below: 1. Political and Regulatory Instruments: Improve norms and policy instruments to strengthen the regulatory framework, guiding territorial planning and public investments toward sustainable agricultural production. Through a participatory and multisectoral approach that brings together public, private, and local actors, it promotes policy coherence, inter-institutional coordination, and the integration of environmental, social, and economic criteria. 2. Soil Geoinformation: Generate and facilitate soil-related information to strengthen the availability, quality, and access to technical and scientific information for sustainable soil management. This enables better territorial and natural resource management. It also promotes the integration of traditional knowledge, with an emphasis on the participation of women and youth. 3. Financial mechanisms: Facilitate access to public and private financial mechanisms to scale up soil restoration and resilient agricultural production. This component is aimed at producers: micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), the private sector, and civil society organizations. . 4. Integrated Bioinputs Management: To increase the supply and demand for bio-inputs (such as compost, humus, among others), under sustainability criteria that contribute to soil recovery and health; biodiversity; and resilient agricultural production. This will be done with the participation of producer organizations and MSMEs, led primarily by women and rural youth.

Das Vorhaben umfasst die Beschaffung und Implementierung der erforderlichen Hard- und Software, die Erstellung digitaler Arbeitsanleitungen, die Durchführung von Schulungen für Fachkräfte sowie Klientinnen und Klienten, die Pilotierung der Lösungen und den anschließenden Rollout auf weitere Arbeitsbereiche. Darüber hinaus sollen begleitende Evaluations- und Qualitätssicherungsmaßnahmen durchgeführt sowie ein Leitfaden zur nachhaltigen Nutzung der entwickelten Lösungen erstellt werden. Ziel des Vorhabens ist der Aufbau digitaler Kompetenzen, die Förderung von Selbstständigkeit und Arbeitsmotivation sowie die Verbesserung von Inklusion, Chancengleichheit und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe sein. Das Vorhaben ist als Teilhabe- und Inklusionsprojekt auszurichten, bei dem digitale Technologien gezielt eingesetzt werden, um Menschen mit Behinderungen verbesserte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und ein höheres Maß an Selbstbestimmung im Arbeitsalltag zu ermöglichen.

title: Germany – Network equipment – DAB-Modulationsautomatik in SFN-Netzen
description: Der NDR ist eine öffentlich-rechtliche Rundfunkanstalt in Deutschland. Er produziert und sendet Programme fürs Fernsehen, Radio und Onlinedienste in den Norddeutschen Bundesländern Hamburg, Niedersachsen, Schleswig-Holstein und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Zu den Aufgaben der Produktionsdirektion gehört es, einen möglichst störungsfreien Betrieb der terrestrischen Senderanlagen zu gewährleisten. Um ein resilientes DAB+ Netz betreiben zu können wurde ein Havariekonzept erarbeitet, welches im Folgenden vorgestellt werden soll. Zur Flächenabdeckung einer Region mit einem DAB+ Kanal betreibt der NDR mehrere Sendeanlagen in mehreren sogenannten SFN (Single Frequency Network): alle Sender in diesem SFN senden mit gleicher Sendefrequenz. Damit sich die ausgesendeten Inhalte der einzelnen Sender nicht gegenseitig stören, müssen zu jeder Zeit an allen Sendern die identischen Daten abgestrahlt werden (Gleichwellennetz). Diese Daten werden zentral im Playout-Center (POC) erzeugt und als EDI-Datenströme an die Senderstandorte übertragen. Die Übertragung erfolgt über angemietete Datenleitungen. Auf die Komponenten dieses Übertragungsnetzes hat der NDR keinen Einfluss. Daher muss der NDR davon ausgehen, dass dieses Netz im Katastrophenfall nicht zur Verfügung steht. Gleiches gilt für unser NDR-IT-Netzwerk, das eine unabhängige Datenverbindung für die Vernetzung von Netzwerkhardware im NDR darstellt. Dieses umfasst z. B. die Management- und Überwachungssysteme für das Sendernetz. Es muss also davon ausgegangen werden, dass die Standorte im Havariefall nicht auf normalem Wege erreichbar und somit steuerbar sind. Folgende Schnittstellen bestehen: Die Ausgänge am Playout (Main und Backup) sowie die Eingänge am Sender sind in Form einer Netzwerkschnittstelle (LAN) per RJ45 ausgeführt. Übertragungsprotokoll ist EDI. Das Netzmanagementsystem im NDR-Netzwerk ist mittels SNMP realisiert. Ziel der Ausschreibung: Wir suchen ein Gerät, das die Leitungszuführung (EDI over IP-Multicast) überwacht und auf Ereignisse und Ausfälle entsprechend unserer Anforderungen laut Leistungsbeschreibung reagiert. Ziel ist es, bei Kommunikationsausfall, ausgewählte Sender in einem SFN weiterhin betreiben zu können. Das Gerät soll mindestens vier Eingänge und zwei Ausgänge für die verschiedenen Schaltungen der Leitungssignale besitzen. Zwei Eingänge sind für die normalen EDI-Signale aus den angemieteten Leitungen, zwei weitere Eingänge sind mit EDI-Signalen durch Reservewege belegt, die vor Ort bereitstehen. Weitere Schnittstellen sind für den Remote- und vor-Ort-Zugriff vorhanden. Dieses Gerät heißt Modulations-Automatik (MA).

Sie agiert dabei im öffentlichen Auftrag, wettbewerbsneutral und setzt das gesamte Spektrum kreditwirtschaftlicher Förderprodukte ein - vom klassischen Kredit bis zur maßgeschneiderten Beratung. Ihre drei Förderfelder sind "Wirtschaft", "Wohnraum" sowie "Infrastruktur/Kommunen". Im Gegensatz zu Geschäftsbanken sind die Kunden der NRW.BANK in erster Linie Hausbanken und andere Fördermittler. Die NRW.BANK beachtet dabei strikt das Diskriminierungsverbot im Verhältnis zu anderen Kreditinstituten. Ihre Zusammenarbeit mit den genossenschaftlichen und privaten Banken sowie den Sparkassen folgt - wettbewerbsneutral - dem Hausbankenverfahren. Das Geschäft der NRW.BANK fokussiert sich auf den Kanon der Förderbereiche, den die Verständigung II definiert. Wettbewerbsgeschäft (wie die gewerbliche Immobilienfinanzierung sowie die Neuemission von Hypothekenpfandbriefen) wurde schon von der Landesbank NRW, dem Vorgängerinstitut der NRW.BANK, nicht mehr verfolgt. Zur Erfüllung ihres Auftrags ist die NRW.BANK in folgenden Bereichen tätig: - Sicherung und Verbesserung der mittelständischen Struktur der Wirtschaft, insbesondere Finanzierungen für Existenzgründungen und -festigungen, - staatliche soziale Wohnraumförderung, - Bereitstellung von Risikokapital, - bauliche Entwicklung der Städte und Gemeinden, - Infrastrukturmaßnahmen, - Maßnahmen in der Land- und Forstwirtschaft und im ländlichen Raum, - Umweltschutz-, Technologie- und Innovationsmaßnahmen, - Maßnahmen sozialer, kultureller und wissenschaftlicher Art.

title: Germany – Urban planning services – Stadtteil- und Citymanagement
description: Die Schloss-Stadt Hückeswagen setzt nun schon seit mehreren Jahren erfolgreich das Integrierte Stadtentwicklungskonzept (ISEK) um. Ein zentraler Baustein dieser Entwicklung ist das etablierte Citymanagement, das seit Frühjahr 2023 als verbindendes Element zwischen Verwaltung, Politik, Bürgerschaft sowie lokalen Akteur:innen und Gewerbetreibenden wirkt. Alle ISEK-Maßnahmen sind einer Übersichtskarte auf der Projektwebseite zu entnehmen: https://www.zukunfthueckeswagen.de/ Vor dem Hintergrund der Beantragung weiterer Fördermittel erfolgt - vorbehaltlich der Bewilligung durch den Fördermittelgeber - eine erneute Ausschreibung des Projekt- und Citymanagements. title: Sweden – Financial analysis and accounting software package – Systemstöd för finansiell planering, analys och styrning
description: Umeå kommun avser upphandla nytt systemstöd för finansiell planering, analys och styrning. Ny lösning ska ge köparen goda förutsättningar att arbeta effektivt och strategiskt med prognostisering, planering, budget och rapportering. En viktig målsättning för köparen är att kunna arbeta datadrivet. En annan att få kontroll och överblick samt kunna kvalitetssäkra beslutsfattande. Leverans ska ske on prem. Umeå kommun avser att upphandla ett användarvänligt och robust budget- och uppföljningssystem som stödjer budgetregistreringsprocessen samt ekonomi- och personaluppföljningsprocesserna.Syftet är att säkerställa ett systemstöd som bidrar till ett effektivt och kvalitativt arbetssätt. Det nuvarande avtalet löper ut den 28 februari 2027. Budget- och uppföljningssystemet används idag främst av chefer/ledare och ekonomer/controllers, men också av andra som måste följa upp en budget mot utfall, exempelvis projektledare och inköpsansvariga kockar samt hr-strateger som behöver se personalinformation. Totalt uppgår antalet unika användare till cirka 700. Det nya systemet ska därför kunna stödja en bred och varierad användargrupp samt erbjuda ett effektivt och lättanvänt stöd för både vana användare och sällananvändare. För användarna ska systemet underlätta och effektivisera både budgetregistrerings-processen och uppföljningsprocesserna. Avtalet utgör ett leverans-, nyttjanderätts- och samarbetsavtal inklusive villkor för support och underhåll. Underhåll omfattar tillgång till nya versioner. Licensen för nyttjanderätt omfattar en icke-exklusiv, i tiden ej begränsad, kommunlicens för kravställd lösning. Avtalet löper från och med dag för undertecknande under 2 år (24 månader). Avtalet förlängs därefter löpande årsvis (12 månader) om avtalet inte sägs upp av beställare minst sex (6) månader innan sista giltighetsdag.

title: Sweden – Agricultural, forestry, horticultural, aquacultural and apicultural services – Sakkunniga inom fastighetsvärdering
description: Välkomna att lämna anbud i upphandling av ett ramavtal för sakkunniga inom fastighetsvärdering. Lantmäteriet genomför fastighetsvärderingar inom ramen för lantmäteriförrättningar. Värderingarna ligger till grund för bedömningar och beslut i ersättningsfrågor och kräver särskild fackkunskap inom fastighetsvärdering. Uppdragen avser vanligtvis bedömning av marknadsvärde eller annan marknadsvärdeminskning enligt vedertagna värderingsmetoder. Lantmäteriet har egen kompetens inom fastighetsvärdering men har därutöver ett återkommande behov av extern sakkunnig kompetens. Syftet med upphandlingen är att säkerställa tillgång till sådan kompetens under Ramavtalets löptid. Lantmäteriet kan i vissa fall även tillgodose behovet inom fastighetsvärdering genom samverkan med andra myndigheter. Sådana uppdrag omfattas inte av Ramavtalet. Lantmäteriet har även behov av resurser för inventering av skogsmark. Lantmäteriets inköp av tjänster motsvarande de tjänster som omfattas av upphandlingen uppgick under 2025 till cirka 17 MSEK exklusive mervärdesskatt. Uppgiften lämnas endast som vägledning och innebär ingen garanti för framtida avropsvolym. Lantmäteriet uppskattar att behovet under Ramavtalets löptid kommer att uppgå till cirka 65 000 000 SEK exklusive mervärdesskatt. Den faktiska omfattningen kan såväl understiga som överstiga det uppskattade värdet. Lantmäteriet garanterar ingen viss volym, något visst antal uppdrag eller något visst ekonomiskt värde. Volymangivelser: Ramavtalets högsta värde under hela dess löptid uppgår till 85 000 000 SEK exklusive mervärdesskatt. När det högsta värdet har uppnåtts får ytterligare avrop inte göras från Ramavtalet.

title: Germany – Firefighting vehicles – Beschaffung eines ferngesteuerten Löschunterstützungsfahrzeugs
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung eines ferngesteuerten Löschunterstützungsfahrzeugs auf Kettenfahrwerk einschließlich sämtlicher für den Betrieb erforderlicher Ausstattungs-, Anbau- und Zubehörteile sowie des Transport-anhängers. Das System soll die Feuerwehr bei der Brandbekämpfung, technischen Unterstützung, Ventilation von Einsatzstellen sowie bei Erkundungs- und Transportaufgaben unterstützen. Insbesondere bei - Brände in öffentlichen und privaten Tiefgaragen und Parkhäusern (erhöhtes Gefährdungspotenzial durch zunehmende E-Mobilität) - Brände in großen Industrie- und Gewerbebetrieben (z.B. Brände in Produktions- und Lagerhallen, Logistikzentren) - Brände in Abfallentsorgungszentren, Umspannwerken - Brände in landwirtschaftlichen Gebäuden (Stallanlagen, Maschinenhallen, große Scheunen mit ggfs. Einsturzgefahr durch Holzkonstruktion) - Wald-, Vegetations- und Böschungsbrände (zunehmendes Gefährdungspotenzial in Folge längerer Hitze- und Dürreperioden) - Verkehrsunfälle mit Fahrzeugbränden auf der A29 Das Fahrzeug muss kompakte Abmessungen aufweisen und gleichzeitig eine hohe Nutzlast, ausreichende Steigfähigkeit sowie eine leistungsfähige Energieversorgung gewährleisten. Bestandteil des Lieferumfangs sind insbesondere ein ferngesteuerter Löschmonitor zur Abgabe von Schaum-Wassergemischen, ein Hochleistungslüfter, verschiedene Video- und Kamerasysteme, Ladegeräte, Fernsteuerungseinrichtungen sowie Anhänger für Transport und Lagerung. Ziel ist die Beschaffung eines sofort einsatzbereiten Gesamtsystems. Das Vergabeverfahren umfasst des Weiteren die Qualifizierung der Bediener und Multiplikatoren des Löschunterstützungsfahrzeuges. Sämtliche Schulungsmodule sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung dargestellt.

title: Poland – Public road transport services – Transport publiczny zbiorowy w Gminie Rudna (2027-2029)
description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest świadczenie usług w zakresie publicznego transportu zbiorowego w gminnych przewozach pasażerskich na terenie Gminy Rudna.Termin realizacji zamówienia: od 01.01.2027 r. do 31.12.2029 r. Każda linia zawiera po 7 kursów z czego 2 kursy będzie obsługiwał autobus (A lub C), natomiast 5 kursów będzie obsługiwał bus (B) – Załącznik nr 2.2 Charakterystyka Część 2 (Rozkłady jazdy) do Wzoru Umowy. Warunkiem koniecznym do przystąpienia do przetargu jest posiadanie co najmniej czterech autobusów o pojemności co najmniej 30 miejsc siedzących oraz czterech busów o pojemności co najmniej 19 miejsc siedzących. Przewidywana wielkość usługi w zakresie przewozów pasażerskich obejmuje w okresie realizacji zamówienia pracę przewozową w rozmiarze minimalnym 583 106,40 wzkm oraz w rozmiarze maksymalnym 613 106,40 wzkm.Wykonawca powinie wykazać, że posiada: aktualną licencję na wykonywanie krajowego transportu drogowego osób lub aktualne zezwolenie na wykonywanie zawodu przewoźnika drogowego, zgodnie obowiązującymi przepisami to jest z ustawą z dnia 6 września 2001 r. o transporcie drogowym oraz, że posiada ubezpieczenie odpowiedzialności cywilnej w zakresie prowadzonej działalności związanej z przedmiotem zamówienia na sumę nie mniejszą niż 500 000,00 zł brutto.

title: Poland – Refuse and waste related services – Odbiór i zagospodarowanie odpadów komunalnych z nieruchomości zamieszkałych zlokalizowanych na obszarze gminy Mały Płock.
description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest: 1) Świadczenie usługi odbioru, transportu i zagospodarowania odpadów komunalnych ze wszystkich nieruchomości, na których zamieszkują mieszkańcy, położonych w granicach administracyjnych gminy Mały Płock polegającej na: a) systematycznym odbieraniu i zagospodarowaniu odpadów komunalnych (zmieszanych i posegregowanych) od właścicieli nieruchomości zamieszkałych na terenie gminy Mały Płock; b) odbiorze i zagospodarowaniu odpadów wielkogabarytowych, zużytego sprzętu elektrycznego i elektronicznego – (w systemie wystawki) zbiórka odpadów i ich odbiór z posesji właścicieli nieruchomości zamieszkałych; c) zapewnieniu, wyposażeniu i obsłudze Punktu Selektywnej Zbiórki Odpadów Komunalnych (PSZOK) zlokalizowanego w obrębie Zakładu Gospodarki Komunalnej w Małym Płocku. d) Wyposażeniu właścicieli nieruchomości w worki na odpady komunalne w okresie obowiązywania umowy. Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia zawarty jest w załączniku nr 5 do SWZ.

title: 10th SFG Advanced Cold Weather Training
description: This is a sources sought notice ONLY. The U.S. Government currently intends to award a contract on a SOLE SOURCE basis but is seeking vendors that may be able to perform this requirement to support a competitive procurement. Accordingly, the U.S. Government highly encourages all interested businesses (large and small) to respond to this source sought. The regulatory authority for the contemplated sole source procurement is the use of simplified acquisition procedures for commercial products and commercial services in accordance with RFO Part 12 and RFO 6.103-1, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirement. The statutory authority at 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1). The proposed sole source vendor is Tyler�s Backcountry LLC. Tyler�s Backcountry LLC provides proprietary training that bridges the gap between civilian advanced avalanche education and military warfare application. They will provide AIARE 1 & 2 courses, backcountry snowmobile mentorship, and instructor certification on the tactics, techniques, and procedures of winter warfare including advanced technics/skills and night navigation to meet training requirements. Please note that this notice is not a Request for Quotations (RFQ); however, any response to this notice must show clear and compelling evidence that the company can provide the required training and facilities. Responsible parties who believe they can meet the requirements are invited to submit in writing complete information describing their ability to provide the product/services no later than 16:00 PM Mountain Standard Time on November 11, 2026. Interest/capability statements may be sent to Joni Wardosky at joni.n.wardosky.civ@army.mil and Becky Hensch at rebecca.s.hensch.civ@army.mil . Merely expressing interest in this procurement will not fulfill the requirements of this notice. The Government will not consider generic capability statements or unilateral expressions of interest. In response to this notice, provide the following: 1. Company Information: Name of the firm, point of contact, phone number, email address, SAM Unique Entity ID, CAGE code, identify business size (large business or a small business). 2. Interest in Competing: Identify whether your firm is interested in competing for this requirement. 3. Capability and Experience: Information in sufficient detail that will facilitate making a capability determination for the ability to teach the training and provide the necessary. Interested vendors should demonstrate the ability to teach all of the following: American Institute for Avalanche Research and Education (AIARE) Rec 1, 2, Snowmobile Instructor Course, Backcountry Snowmobile Mentorship to the military for winter warfare including, advanced techniques and skills, and training in low and no light.
